versionDescription: Purchase Orders: edit an order (supplier, reference, dates, approver, notes), edit or remove lines, add items to an open order, Mark as Draft / Place order, and Save as Draft on new orders. Inventory: supplier filter, select-all, Select low/out of stock, and Reorder Selected now makes one order per supplier (e.g. TMXA, McMaster-Carr) with unit costs prefilled.
